title: Learn Hip Hop Dance: Harlem Shake

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher uses a direct, encouraging tone, focusing on breaking down movements into simple, repeatable components. He emphasizes the importance of rhythm and body dynamics, using verbal cues to guide the student through the steps.

lesson_structure.note: The teacher breaks down the basic groove.
The teacher adds a double shake to the basic groove.
The teacher adds arm movements to the groove.
The teacher demonstrates how to add personality to the dance.
The teacher practices the dance with music.

cues: pay attention to those technical terms
common_mistakes: confusing the order of the boom-boom-ba

steps_taught.name: Harlem Shake
steps_taught.description: A rhythmic movement involving a shoulder shake and hip movement.

what_works: The use of a split-screen view allows for a clear view of both the full body and the footwork.
The teacher breaks down the movement into small, manageable parts.
what_hinders: The lack of a slow-motion breakdown for the arm movements might make it difficult for some to follow.

quotes.text: The first thing you want to do is get the groove.
Really pay attention to those technical terms because they're important.
We'll try out what you've learned.

evidence_segments.observation: The teacher introduces the dance and sets the stage for the lesson.
The teacher demonstrates the basic groove, focusing on shoulder and hip movement.
The teacher adds a double shake to the basic groove.
The teacher incorporates arm movements into the existing groove.
The teacher explains how to add personal style to the dance.
The teacher performs the full dance sequence with music.

extraction.distinctive_method: The teacher uses a split-screen view to show both the full body and a close-up of the feet, which is a helpful way to teach dance steps.
